label: Batu Pahat restaurant kitchen fire

sequence: Cooking oil overheats at the wok burner of the main gas stove, left unattended
Flames enter the exhaust hood and ducting and spread across the kitchen ceiling

gates.name: Period of insurance
gates.reason: Loss on 12 August 2023 falls inside 1 May 2023 to 30 April 2024.

gates.name: Peril insured
gates.reason: Proximate cause: fire, from overheated cooking oil, with no intervening event. Accidental kitchen fire is the base insured peril. No explosion; Condition 8(h) not engaged.

gates.name: Conditions precedent
gates.reason: Notice on 12 August 2023; written claim delivered 20 August 2023, day 8 of 15.

gates.name: Endorsement held
gates.reason: No endorsement required for fire; none on the schedule.

gates.name: Endorsement satisfied
gates.reason: No warranties. Condition 9 not engaged: trading daily, occupation unchanged.

gates.name: Item admitted
gates.reason: Four of seven items admitted. Cash (ref 5) and sales books (ref 7) fall out under Condition 8(e); the motorcycle (ref 6) is not property insured under any schedule item. The claim stands for the rest.
